## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what a user can do after this change.

## Validation

- Production build (`npm run build`):
- Manual workflow checked, environment, and result:
- Not tested / remaining limitations:

For visible changes, include screenshots where useful. A passing build does not verify audio, microphone behavior, or the packaged desktop app.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] The change has a focused scope.
- [ ] No credentials, private scores, personal paths, or user data are included.
- [ ] New third-party material has source and license information.
- [ ] Documentation and known issues reflect the resulting behavior where relevant.
